name: What information should I have ready when calling for no hot water service?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready when calling for no hot water service?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you call for no hot water service, having key information ready can help our technicians diagnose the issue more efficiently. Please be prepared to describe the problem (e.g., no hot water at all, lukewarm water, strange noises), mention the type of water heater you have (gas, electric, tankless), and note any recent events or maintenance. Knowing the approximate age of your water heater, if possible, can also be helpful for our technicians to prepare for potential solutions or replacement options.
acceptedAnswer.description: When calling for service, prepare to describe the problem, mention your water heater type and age, and any recent events to aid diagnosis.
